about.title: About me
about.p1: Hello! I'm Bruno Rhis, an IT professional with over 8 years of solid experience in infrastructure and support, dedicating recent years exclusively to Offensive Security.
about.p2: I work conducting penetration testing (Pentest) and Red Team operations, simulating real attacks, running controlled phishing campaigns, and evaluating the security of complex corporate environments. I also use Threat Intelligence knowledge to complement tactical threat identification and analysis.
about.p3: I have a degree in Cyber Defense and hold the OSCP+, OSCP, CRTP, and DCPT certifications. My practical experience involves identifying, exploiting, and validating vulnerabilities in applications, networks, and infrastructures, always aiming to strengthen organizations' security posture.

services.title: Professional Services
services.description: I offer offensive security solutions tailored to your business needs to ensure the integrity and confidentiality of your data.

items.title: Web App Pentesting
items.description: Deep analysis of web applications seeking critical flaws (OWASP Top 10), business logic issues, and API vulnerabilities.

items.title: Network Pentesting
items.description: Security assessment of corporate network infrastructure, identifying open ports, outdated services, and segmentation flaws.

items.title: Vulnerability Assessment
items.description: Automated scanning and manual triage to map the organization's attack surface and prioritize remediations.

items.title: API Pentesting
items.description: Security assessment focused on REST and GraphQL APIs to discover authentication, authorization, and data manipulation flaws.

items.title: Red Team Operations
items.description: Realistic simulation of targeted attacks to test your organization's detection and response capabilities (Blue Team).

items.title: Wi-Fi Pentesting
items.description: Penetration testing on corporate wireless networks to identify weak encryption, insecure configurations, and network attacks.

items.title: Security Audit
items.description: Detailed review of architecture, Active Directory, and cloud configurations to ensure cybersecurity best practices.

items.title: Phishing Campaigns
items.description: Simulation of social engineering attacks to assess the level of security awareness of employees and the effectiveness of controls.
